records.author: Copilot
records.body:
Establishes foundational repository structure for GPT-BRG07, a BrandGuard™ implementation for LVMH luxury brand protection.

## Files Added

- **LICENSE** — MIT License
- **.gitignore** — Standard patterns for OS, IDE, build artifacts, dependencies
- **gpt_manifest.yaml** — Project metadata and canonical tagline

```yaml
tagline: "Luxury should never be automated without your blessing."

links:
  official_site: "https://www.lvmh.com"
  askjamie_lens: "https://askjamie.ai/lens/brg07-lvmh"
  chatgpt_project: "[private source link omitted]"
  notion_page: "[private source link omitted]"
  custom_gpt: "[private source link omitted]"
```

## Directories Created

- `/prompts` — GPT system and user prompts
- `/src` — Source code and utilities
- `/build` — Build artifacts and distributions
- `/eval` — Evaluation tests and QA
- `/ops` — Deployment and infrastructure
- `/web` — Web assets and documentation

Each directory includes `.gitkeep` for version control tracking.

Add gpt_manifest.yaml containing the canonical tagline “Luxury should never be automated without your blessing.” and links to the official site, AskJamie lens page, ChatGPT Project, Notion page, and Custom GPT.
> 


</details>

review_comments.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
review_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Use a Replit-supported Nix channel**

For Replit workspaces that import this repo, this moves the environment to `stable-26_05` even though Replit's public `nixpkgs-replit` channel updater currently only includes stable bases through `nixpkgs-25.11`; the audit passes because it compares this string to upstream NixOS release notes, not to Replit channel availability. Keep the latest Replit-supported channel, or verify/add Replit support for 26.05 before updating this config, otherwise the workspace can fail to resolve its Nix channel.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

reviews.body:
### 🟢 Ready to approve

The changes are small, internally consistent across `.replit` and both inventories, and align with the stated PR goal of resolving audit drift.

*This review doesn't count toward merge requirements. [Sign up for the private preview]([private source link omitted]) to control whether Copilot approvals count.*

<details>
<summary>Pull request overview</summary>

Resolves technology-version audit drift for this documentation/asset repository by aligning the Replit Nix channel and the checked-in technology inventories with the currently reviewed stable NixOS release.

**Changes:**
- Bump Replit Nix channel from `stable-25_05` to `stable-26_05`.
- Update `ops/technology-inventory.json` to reflect the new Nix/Nixpkgs current version.
- Update `docs/technology-inventory.md` to keep the human-readable inventory in sync with the machine-readable inventory.
</details>

<details>
<summary>File summaries</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| ops/technology-inventory.json | Updates the recorded Nix/Nixpkgs current version to `stable-26_05` to match the reviewed stable line. |
| docs/technology-inventory.md | Synchronizes the Markdown inventory row for Nix/Nixpkgs with the updated Replit channel/version. |
| .replit | Advances the Replit `[nix]` channel to `stable-26_05` to resolve the detected drift. |
</details>

<details>
<summary>Review details</summary>

- **Files reviewed:** 3/3 changed files
- **Comments generated:** 0
- **Review effort level:** Lite
</details>
